title: Beautiful big mugs
text: Beautiful big mugs. I purchased 2 different designs to gift to 2 different people. They are weighty but not too much and print design is dynamic. They are larger - not a tiny cup of tea or coffee. Comes in a nice gift able box. Loved them and both were very well received.

product_metadata.title: Karma Gifts 16 oz Black and White Boho Mug Dog - Cute Coffee and Tea Mug - Ceramic Coffee Mugs for Women and Men
features: INSPIRATIONAL: Look forward to your daily beverage with our big coffee mugs. They feature unique feel-good prints that positively jump-start the day or end the night.

UNIQUE DESIGNS: With one-of-a-kind illustrations and drawings, everyone can choose from our selection of large mugs. Pair our coffee mug with our coordinating Boho tea towels for a matching decorative style in the kitchen.

COLLECT THEM ALL: This collection includes nature-inspired mugs. Each fun mug displays plants, animals, insects, and a calming message. Complete your assortment and add them to your coffee and tea collection.

PERFECT SIZE: These cool coffee mugs make great gifts for coffee lovers. They hold up to 16 oz of your favorite refreshment, are microwave and dishwasher-safe, have a durable handle, and measure 4.25" L x 3.7" W.

KARMA: We offer stunning and functional gifts and décor with unique, thoughtful designs and positive sentiments. Choose from our exclusive and expansive line of bags, stationery, travel accessories, apparel, and home goods for any occasion.
description: Start the day with our artist-designed 16 oz Black and White Boho Mug. Exclusive to Karma Gifts, our ceramic coffee cups feature beautifully curated artwork and uplifting quotes by in-house illustrators and designers. The 16oz coffee mug is microwave and dishwasher-safe, has a durable handle, and measures 4.25" L x 3.7" W. They are ideal for coffee lovers but also make great tea gifts for women and men.
